gaps.detail: archwiz/mapping_pointer_index.py is cited as the mapping-pointer-index/v1 contract by docs/linguist/ACTIONS-MAPPING-RECOVERY.md, docs/proposals/active/notation-sets/NSE-020-MAPPING-POINTER-ROUNDTRIP.md, ROUNDTRIP-IMPLEMENTATION.md and scripts/linguist/index_alignment.py, but the file does not exist on master. NOT ESTABLISHED as implemented.
REV_GRIMOIRE_MAP / REV_SYMBOL_MAP are named in ACTIONS-MAPPING-RECOVERY.md as historical reverse tables; on master only REV_MAP (derived from SYMBOL_MAP) exists in cedrlang.py.
docs/proposals/active/linguist-machine-parity/ holds LMP-01 as a posted placeholder only: zero mapping entries, implementation not authorized there. No family emitted.
CedarIndex live registrations live in ~/.cedar/cedar_index.json (runtime-local). The feed carries only the 45 seed commands from cid.py ALL_COMMANDS.
PR #154's encrypted private mapping-pointer store and Actions obfuscation hooks are proposed in ACTIONS-MAPPING-RECOVERY.md, not verified as deployed. No family emitted.
